title: Pod Salt Nexus Orange Mango Lime Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Orange Mango Lime from Pod Salt’s Nexus collection is a giddy mix of summer flavours with big, juicy flavours of juicy Orange, luscious, tropical Mango and sharp and zesty Lime. A mouth-watering blend that’s perfect for hot, lazy summer days. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit. Nexus is a next-generation E-liquid range from award-winning e-liquid makers Pod Salt. These astounding e-liquids have been molecularly engineered to be Pod Salt’s most advanced and accurate flavours yet. In addition to their deliciously complex and sophisticated blends of fruit flavours, Pod Salt Nexus nic salt e-liquids’ premium nicotine salt formula is absorbed faster, lasts longer and produces a greater level of satisfaction than traditional Freebase e-liquids. If you enjoy this flavour then there are several more delicious vapes to explore in Pod Salt’s fabulous Nexus collection of nic salt e-liquids. From tropical-tinged taste sensations like Pineapple Passion Lime to candy-coated treats like Sour Blue Raspberry, Nexus e-liquids are flavours made to satisfy and delight every vaper.
